_readme: The vendoring contract. Files listed here are copied VERBATIM from Karafilt.
Never edit a vendored file in place — edit it upstream in Karafilt and re-sync,
or promote it to a fork (move it out of this list and record why in _promotions).
Run `scripts/sync-shared.sh` to pull upstream changes and refresh the hashes.
_globalNames: Vendored files set Karafilt* globals (window.KarafiltSongMatch, KarafiltLineTokens,
KarafiltVideoKey, KarafiltFancySelect). DO NOT rename them during sync.
Verbatim vendoring makes the drift check a plain SHA-256 comparison. A sync script
that rewrites identifiers turns every drift check into a semantic diff, and the
discipline dies within a month. Alias at the point of use instead — which is what
Karafilt itself already does at service-worker.js:7 (`const SM = self.KarafiltSongMatch;`).

files.why: Title -> {artist, track} candidate parsing + fuzzy match scoring. UMD, DOM-free, no chrome.*. Maintained in 4 places across the family today; this is the one worth never forking.
Stable per-song identity (yt:<id> / sp:<id> / host+path). Instrufilt keys its chord-chart cache on exactly this, so it MUST agree with Karafilt and Karalyr byte for byte.
Lyric line -> word span tokenisation. Consumed by the panel's makeLineEl; the lead sheet wraps its output rather than changing it.
Progressive enhancement of a native <select> into option cards, keeping the <select> as source of truth. Reused verbatim for the isolation-mode picker.

Per-site strategy (Spotify virtual media element; generic pipeline elsewhere). NOTE: Instrufilt needs isAd() on the YouTube path — contribute that UPSTREAM to Karafilt first (its lyrics mis-fire on ads too), then re-sync. Do not fork this file for it.
MAIN-world hook that captures Spotify's never-attached <audio>. Pure playback-state relay, entirely independent of what the extension does with audio.
Vendored KissFFT (BSD-3). Upstream-of-upstream; tracked here only so an accidental local edit is caught.
Run UNMODIFIED against the vendored song-match.js. A vendored test passing unmodified is the vendoring proof — it catches 'hash matched but a global collided'.
